استأويا (form X)
# اِسْتَأْوَيَا (istaʔwayā) /is.taʔ.wa.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِسْتَأْوَى (istaʔwā)
# اِسْتَأْوِيَا (istaʔwiyā) /is.taʔ.wi.jaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَأْوَى (istaʔwā)
